sentences.japanese: 勤務中はタバコを吸わない方がいいよ。
sentences.english: You had better not smoke while on duty.

sentences.japanese: 君は煙草を吸うのをやめるのが先決だ。
sentences.english: First, you have to stop smoking.

sentences.japanese: 君は煙草を吸うのをやめることが必要だ。
sentences.english: It is necessary for you to stop smoking.

sentences.japanese: 君はたばこを吸い過ぎだ。減らすべきだ。
sentences.english: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.

sentences.japanese: 君はここでたばこを吸うことを禁じられている。
sentences.english: You are prohibited from smoking here.
